description: This file defines the abstract class MidiPortSelector, which is part of a MIDI device selection UI component for Android applications. It manages a Spinner UI element to list available MIDI ports, reacts to device add/remove events, handles port selection, and tracks busy ports.

classes.name: MidiPortSelector
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides UI for selecting MIDI ports using a Spinner widget. It manages device and port changes, maintains a list of busy ports, and defines callback methods for port selection and cleanup.

methods.name: MidiPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes MIDI device callback, populates device list, and sets up UI Spinner for selecting MIDI ports.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Resets the Spinner selection to no port.

methods.name: onDeviceAdded
methods.description: Handles addition of a new MIDI device and populates available ports into the UI list.

methods.name: onDeviceRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a MIDI device, updating the UI and current selection accordingly.

methods.name: onDeviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Tracks changes in device port status (busy/free) and updates the UI's port list.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Abstract method to handle user selection of a MIDI port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Abstract method to handle cleanup when the selector is closed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Calls the onClose() method to perform cleanup.
